content: Aditya Singh followed up with insurance agent Neha Kapoor regarding his lapsed health insurance policy (SH-123456). Neha informed him that the total due to reinstate the policy is 15,500 INR, which includes the missed premium and a reinstatement fee. Aditya was informed that payment can be made online and that the policy will be active from the date of payment.

action_items: Pay the total due amount of 15,500 INR online or via payment link
Confirm if the reinstatement terms work for the customer
